notes: SQS pricing and SNS pricing tables are not Markdown tables in the snapshots (no header row), and M4 forbids quoting table text as a sentence, so per-request rates and some table cells are not facts. EventBridge per-million rates are read from the worked examples (kind price).

SQS queue-types page says FIFO high-throughput mode scales to 30,000 TPS and 300 API calls per second per method for the queue; the quotas page says per partition 300 TPS and up to 70,000 TPS (Region-dependent). Quotas page used as current truth.

SNS General Reference row says maximum message size 262,144 bytes (256 KiB); the SNS guide says that is the default and 1 MiB is possible with MaximumMessageSize. Default fact is examinable; the 1 MiB opt-in facts say not examinable yet.
SQS in-flight: the visibility timeout page says FIFO limits depend on active message groups; the FIFO quotas page says 120,000 in-flight. Quotas page used.

The EventBridge quota page lists the new Custom Event Bus quotas first (5 buses, 100 PutEvents entries, retry 185, 300 seconds dedup window); these are not examinable yet and were not mined as facts. Classic quotas (100 buses, 300 rules, 5 targets) were mined.

d009.note: Middle Region tiers (19,000, 9,000, 4,500 TPS) not adopted.
